purpose: Skeleton-first adult male hyoid geometry target. Replace the a003 schematic reference stick with a landmark-rich single-bone reference while preserving the no-osseous-articulation rule.
conventional_bone_count_policy: The hyoid remains one conventional adult bone. Body and cornua are regions/landmarks of that one bone, not additional bones.
articulation_policy: No osseous parent is created. The hyoid remains a suspended REFERENCE structure; motion coupling, if modeled later, is soft-tissue functional mechanics rather than a bone-to-bone joint.

source_evidence.citation: Fakhry N et al. Analysis of hyoid bone using 3D geometric morphometrics. Dysphagia. 2013;28(3):435-445.
source_evidence.sample: 88 cadaveric intact hyoids plus 92 living-adult CT hyoids
source_evidence.note: Length and width were significantly larger in men; hyoid length correlated positively with stature (r=0.533) and weight (r=0.497). Exact endpoint definitions are not exposed in the PubMed abstract, so use these as gross cross-checks rather than direct coordinate equations.

source_evidence.citation: Abdelkader A et al. Hyoid bone-based sex discrimination among Egyptians using multidetector computed tomography. Sci Rep. 2025;15:2680.

measurement_definitions.overall_width: linear distance between the most lateral points of the greater horns
measurement_definitions.overall_length: perpendicular length from the most anterior edge of the hyoid body to the line joining the most distal points of the greater horns
measurement_definitions.greater_horn_lengths: right/left greater horn lengths per the paper's 3D landmarks
measurement_definitions.greater_horn_center_distance: distance between centers of greater horns
measurement_definitions.greater_horn_posterior_end_distance: distance between posterior ends of greater horns

landmark_semantics_review.checked: Table 1, Figure 1B/C and Results; original figure visually inspected
landmark_semantics_review.observation: Figure 1B places D/E on free horn tips and Dprime/Eprime near the body; Table 1 calls Dprime-Eprime the posterior-end span. Figure 1C measures width near distal lateral points.
landmark_semantics_review.inference: The printed label cannot be assigned to distal-tip coordinates until this figure/text conflict is resolved.
landmark_semantics_review.rule: GGprime cursor points are not proven volume centroids or neutral centreline points. Neither marginal span mean prescribes cornu bending; preserve straight-horn plausibility from independent anatomy.
landmark_semantics_review.needed: Endpoint-matched independent geometry or source landmark clarification; individual stature and full 3D coordinates.

source_evidence.citation: Evaluation of hyoid bone position, shape, area, volume, and tongue volume. 2024/2025.
source_evidence.finding: Hyoid position was proportionally at the C3 vertebral level in both sexes.
source_evidence.use: Vertical-level anchor and whole-bone envelope plausibility after the canonical cervical spine is rebuilt.

current_a003.control_stick_semantics: single AP-oriented reference stick with no measurement-compatible whole-bone endpoint definition
current_a003.marker_semantics_warning: These markers are body↔cornu junction/contact markers, not the same landmarks as greater-horn centres, posterior horn ends, lateral-most horn points or lesser-horn tips in the cited morphometry.
current_a003.current_recipe: Anterior neck below the mandible near C3.
current_a003.reading: A003 is topologically correct (one unpaired hyoid, no osseous parent) but geometrically schematic; its stick/marker spans cannot be treated as whole-bone dimensions.

local_frame.Y: posterior direction after canonical head/neck frame mapping
local_frame.placement_rule: Anchor the whole local hyoid frame near the canonical C3 level only after the C2-S1 spine/endplate frame is rebuilt. Do not preserve the old absolute Z merely to fit the r95 neck mesh.

provisional_local_geometry.warning: The 2013 and 2025 overall length definitions are not guaranteed identical and hyoid length is stature-sensitive. The gross corridor is a cross-check, not an instruction to average endpoints.

body_SI_height.definition: Body minor axis shown vertically in Figure 1A

body_AP_thickness.definition: Body AP thickness per Table 1 and Figure 1B

body_thickness.warning: Generic historical alias; AP thickness, not superior-inferior height

hard_invariants: body, greater cornua and lesser cornua belong to one conventional bone
left/right horn landmarks are distinct and mirror-consistent in the canonical neutral frame
overall width is measured at lateral-most greater-horn points, not body-cornu junctions
overall AP length is measured from anterior body edge to the distal-horn-tip line, not from the old control-stick endpoints
acceptance_tests: Store explicit 3D landmarks for body centre/axes, bilateral greater-horn centres and tips, and bilateral lesser-horn references.
Directly recomputed width/length from canonical landmarks agrees with the selected source corridor under matching definitions.
Canonical hyoid vertical level is checked against the rebuilt C3 frame rather than r95 surface height.
No skull/cervical bone is made an osseous parent of the hyoid.
Any future swallow/breathing hyoid motion remains outside the rigid osseous articulation solver unless separately sourced as functional soft-tissue mechanics.

source_axis_review_2026_10_08.checked: Table 1 printed page 3; Figure 1A/B printed page 4; Results printed page 6
source_axis_review_2026_10_08.correction: Remove incorrect AP label from BB-prime minor axis; CC-prime 6.99 mm is AP thickness. BB-prime vertical extent is mapped provisionally to local Z; neutral body tilt is not specified by population means.
remaining_blockers: Independent endpoint-matched body/cornu geometry and stature context before numeric freeze
Body tilt, cornu curves and landmark coordinates are not uniquely specified by marginal means
Canonical C3-relative placement; C3 level alone does not specify AP position
